mapper.update: update seckill_activity set available_count = available_count - 1, lock_count = lock_count + 1, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 and available_count > 0 and now() between start_time and end_time
update seckill_activity set available_count = available_count + 1, lock_count = lock_count - 1, update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId} and lock_count > 0
mapper.select: select activity_id from seckill_activity where status = 1

select id, activity_id, activity_name, source, channel, goods_id, seckill_price, total_count, available_count, lock_count, take_limit_count, status, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time from seckill_activity where status = 1 and start_time <= date_add(now(), interval #{beforeMinutes} minute) and end_time > now() order by start_time asc, activity_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update seckill_activity a left join ( select activity_id, count(*) as order_count from seckill_order where activity_id = #{activityId} and status in (0, 1) group by activity_id ) o on a.activity_id = o.activity_id set a.lock_count = coalesce(o.order_count, 0), a.available_count = greatest(a.total_count - coalesce(o.order_count, 0), 0), a.update_time = now() where a.activity_id = #{activityId}
update seckill_activity set lock_count = #{activeCount}, available_count = greatest(total_count - #{activeCount}, 0), update_time = now() where activity_id = #{activityId}
